entries.english: Map your route through the satellite network to connect the user terminal to the internet.
entries.previousEnglish: Build a route through the satellite network to connect the subscriber terminal to the internet

entries.english:
A new user terminal was installed at an isolated research station. Arrange the satellite communications network elements and define their connections to each other. The team needs to get the station online via the satellite infrastructure for the first time. To do this, the role of each element must be determined and the signal route must be set up correctly.
After the route is assembled, the system will check the connection. If all devices are arranged in the correct sequence, the signal will pass from the terminal through the satellite and the ground station to the data processing center, and the station will receive stable internet access.

Mission: Determine the correct sequence of network elements and initiate the signal.
entries.previousEnglish:
A new subscriber terminal has been installed at a remote research outpost. Place the satellite communication network components and define their connections to one another. The team needs to bring the outpost online through satellite infrastructure for the first time. To do this, identify the role of each component and build the signal route in the correct order.
Once the route is assembled, the system will check the connection. If all devices are in the correct sequence, the signal will travel from the terminal through the satellite and ground station to the data center, giving the outpost stable internet access.

Task: determine the correct sequence of network components and launch the signal.

entries.english:
An isolated location in the Arctic is outside the coverage area. A site for a ground station can only be chosen where the essential infrastructure is available.

Mission: Determine the orbital altitude and the number of satellites. Find a suitable location for the ground station.

entries.english: Set 3 · CONNECTIVITY FOR A LARGE COUNTRY
Transfer corporate data from Kaliningrad to Vladivostok, across the entire country.
entries.previousEnglish: Transmit corporate data across the country from Kaliningrad to Vladivostok

entries.english:
User terminals in Kaliningrad and on a ship arriving in Vladivostok are separated by the entire country, so a single satellite is not sufficient.

Mission: Position the elements of the satellite communications network across the entire country to create a reliable route for data transmission.
Here’s a little hint: the data processing center connects the western and eastern ends of the country in the middle.
entries.previousEnglish:
The subscriber terminals in Kaliningrad and on a ship arriving in Vladivostok are separated by the entire country, so one satellite is not enough for this route.

Task: distribute satellite communication network components across the country to create a reliable route for data transmission.
A small hint: a data center in the middle connects the western and eastern parts of the country.
